channel.description:
I'm James! I build planes, rockets, boats and other vehicles to inspire you to build things too! 🚀

Answers to some common questions:

1. I learned almost everything by building with cardboard and LEGO as a kid.
2. I don’t have an engineering degree. 
3.  You don’t need to be an expert to build something amazing. That’s why we now make Project Air model kits so you can build flying model airplanes

videos.t: How to WATER PROOF FOAM BOARD!
videos.desc:
Ever wondered how to make your foam board planes last longer and not be subjugated to the ravages of time (and water)? Well look no further. Today I test out three different varnishes to see if any have any affects on making foam board more water resistant so that your foam board planes can be more resilient to rapid decay and water damage. 

If you liked this, please like comment and subscribe to stay up to date and help me out in these early stages of video making on youtube!

Check out the Project Air website here (for lots of cool extra stuff) - www.projectair.co.uk

videos.t: RC Bluebird K7 - EDF Jet Boat Build
videos.desc:
Check out www.projectair.co.uk and the workshop post relating to this project. 

This week I introduce the first of a long line of exciting projects from project air - Bluebird K7. This is a one off build is of a jet boat that set seven World Water Speed Records in the 1950s and 1960s. Like the real one, this model uses aircraft parts, such as the EDF unit that will push the craft to extremely high speeds! 

Launch is scheduled for late July so stick around and subscribe so that you don't miss the coming build videos, along with the final video of it roaring along Lake Coniston.
